service.description: The invoices of projects among the projects the user sees (every project for ADMIN), by kind: client (to a project's client: linked by WorkEffortInvoice or billing its time, TimeEntry.invoiceId), worker (a worker's time, TimeEntry.vendorInvoiceId) or expense (linked by WorkEffortInvoice, from someone else). invoiceIds narrows to those; rootWorkEffortId to one project. invoiceMap: invoiceId to {kind, projectIds}. No money check: the callers make it.

For a client (PROJECT_CLIENT; isClient false and nothing for anyone else), the invoices it may read: a client invoice (get#InvoiceProjects kind client: to the project's client, or billing its time) of one of its client projects (mantle.work.ProjectServices.get#ClientProjectInfo clientProjectIds: client sign-in on), addressed to the client's own party or organization (clientPartyIds), and sent to it (Sent, Acknowledged or Payment Received: never a draft, an approved invoice not sent yet, or a cancelled one). Never a worker or expense invoice, nor one of a project of the same organization without client sign-in. invoiceIds narrows to those, rootWorkEffortId to one project. invoiceMap: invoiceId to {kind, projectIds (its client projects only)}; shareHoursProjectIds: the client projects that share their hours. Strict: anything that fails is logged and the client sees nothing.

Whether the user may see an invoice in Projects: one who manages money (check#Money) and sees one of its projects (get#InvoiceProjects); a client (PROJECT_CLIENT) only to view (need view or none; any other need is refused) one of its own invoices (get#ClientInvoices), with clientView true; else "not available" as an error, or with need none only the answer. kind: client, worker or expense. The services that change an invoice pass need change.

Unbilled's Client billing list (design-projects.md §10 UnbilledList): by project, the billable time not invoiced (mantle.work.ProjectServices.get#UnbilledSummary) with its texts: the client, the billing basis, hours and amount, the approved part ready to invoice, what waits for approval, entries without a rate, the period, the last invoice, the drafts, and whether it may be invoiced now (and why not); the totals and the clients for the find. Those who do not manage money get an error.

service.description: CreateProjectInvoice's dialog (design-projects.md §10): a project's approved billable time not invoiced, entry by entry with its rate and amount (those without a rate flagged), and what waits for approval; the client's open drafts of the project to add to; the grouping (the project's WstInvoiceGrouping: per entry, per worker, one line) and the payment terms (the organization's ProjBillingDefaults settlementTermId) to default to. For one who manages money and manages the project.

Unbilled's Create invoice (design-projects.md §10 CreateProjectInvoice): a client invoice of a project's approved billable time (mantle.account.InvoiceServices.create#ProjectInvoiceItems with approvedOnly and billableOnly), the selected entries only when timeEntryIds is given, and of its milestone billing shares due (milestoneIds, each 'milestoneId:orderId:orderItemSeqId' or a milestone id: create#MilestoneInvoiceItems; impl-projects.md P8b), added to an open draft of the project to the same client (invoiceId) or a new one dated invoiceDate with the payment terms; the time's lines per entry, per worker or one line (entryGrouping). The project's expenses not billed through go with the time. For one who manages money and manages the project; refused when the project has no client or vendor, a selected entry is not approved, invoiced already or has no rate, or a selected share is not due. All or nothing, in one transaction.

parameter.name: timeEntryIds
parameter.description: The selected entries: a list or a comma list.

parameter.name: milestoneIds
parameter.description: The selected milestone shares: a list or a comma list.

parameter.name: selection
parameter.description: The dialog's selection: none selected is an error rather than all.

service.description: Invoices (design-projects.md §10 Invoices): the invoices of the projects the user sees (get#InvoiceProjects), for one who manages money; for a client (clientView) its own sent invoices only (get#ClientInvoices), whatever money it manages, with the chips Sent, Overdue, Paid and All. Chips with counts: Drafts (In-Process, or a worker's Incoming and Received), To send (approved, Finalized), Sent (Sent, Acknowledged), Overdue (approved or sent, unpaid, past due), Paid, Worker invoices, All (cancelled ones too). The find: project, client, kind, status, and an invoice date period. Each row: the invoice, its kind, projects, from, to, date, due, total, unpaid and the status chip, newest first.

InvoiceDetail in the Projects context (design-projects.md §10 InvoiceDetail): for one who manages money and sees one of its projects (get#InvoiceAccess), else detail is null. The header (from, to, dates, terms, status, reference, description, message, totals), the lines with the time behind each (mantle.account.InvoiceServices.get#InvoiceTimeDetail: who, when, work item, hours, rate, amount, comment), the projects, the payments applied, the email address to send it to (the client's billing email, else its billing contact's or its own primary one) and the moves the user may make: approve (In-Process to Finalized), send (approves first), resume changes (Finalized to In-Process), cancel (In-Process or Finalized: frees its time), edit and remove a line (In-Process). Worker and expense invoices are read only here. For a client (get#InvoiceAccess clientView: its own sent invoice, impl-projects.md P10b) the detail is read only (no move, no address to send to, no order link), and its time is only that of the projects sharing their hours with it, each entry as its day, work item (a shared item by name, any other as other work) and hours, never who, a rate, an amount or a comment; hoursText sums those.

InvoiceDetail's moves on a client invoice of a project (get#InvoiceAccess), through Mantle's change#InvoiceState with its period, posting and application checks: approve (finalized: posted to the ledger when the organization keeps one), resume (back to In-Process, with a reason) and cancel (its time is unbilled again, mantle.account.InvoiceServices.cancel#Invoice through its rule).

return.message: Only a client invoice is changed here

set.from: {approve:'Invoice approved', resume:'Invoice open to changes again', cancel:'Invoice cancelled; its time is unbilled again'}

An address that is not one is named and the others are sent; an email the mail server does not take waits in the Outbox, which is said. Sending the same again answers the first result.

service.description: Rates (design-projects.md §10 Rates): the RateAmount rows of client billing (RaprClient), worker pay (RaprVendor) or labor costing (RaprCost, People P10: read only, Accounting's) on the projects the user sees or on none (a person's, a work type's or everyone's), as check#RateAccess admits: every list for one who manages money; for a holder of PAYROLL_VIEW without money (People's Rates) the employees' pay rates alone (a RaprVendor rate of a person employed now by an employer of their People scope, get#PayrollEmployees, on any project) and the costing rates. The find: project, person, work type, position class, rate type, and effective on a day (else the current and coming rates; ended ones with showEnded). Each row: the rate type, project, person, position class, work type, from, thru, amount and currency, whether it is current, coming or ended; a labor costing rate only of the organizations the user reads, or shared (find#CostingRates). The worker pay rate of a person who is an employee is the employee's pay (mantle.humanres.EmploymentServices.get#PayRateAccess): its amount only with PAYROLL_VIEW (else amountText says payroll sets it), and changed (canChange) only with PAYROLL_EDIT; a costing rate is never changed here. counts: the rows of each list the user reads.

Rates' New rate and Edit (design-projects.md §10 NewRate, RateList), for one who manages money. A new rate (mantle.humanres.RateServices.create#RateAmount): its purpose, rate type, project (one the user sees, or none), person, position class, work type, from (today by default), thru, amount and currency, per hour. An edit (rateAmountId; mantle.humanres.RateServices.update#RateAmount) changes only the dates and the amount: to change what a rate applies to, end it and add another. A rate of a project the user does not see is refused. Rates found for time entries already are kept on them (TimeEntry.rateAmountId): an amount changed here changes what their time not yet invoiced bills at (ProjectTime's Update rates finds the rates again). A worker pay rate (RaprVendor) of a person who is an employee is the employee's pay: added or changed only with PAYROLL_EDIT (mantle.humanres.EmploymentServices.get#PayRateAccess), refused without it. A payroll user without money (check#RateAccess payOnly; People's Rates) adds and changes only an employee's pay rate, on no project. A labor costing rate is not changed here (Accounting's CostingPolicies).

Rates' End: a rate ends now (thruDate), for one who manages money; the time already logged keeps it. A worker pay rate of a person who is an employee only with PAYROLL_EDIT (mantle.humanres.EmploymentServices.get#PayRateAccess), by payroll without money too (check#RateAccess payOnly: an employee's pay rate alone). A costing rate is not ended here.
The choices of Rates' forms: the open projects the user sees (not templates), the work types offered (WorkType), the position classes and the rate types (RateType, Standard first).

Rates' Which rate (design-projects.md §10 WhichRate): the client and the worker rate that apply to a person's time on a project or work item, of a work type, on a day (mantle.work.TimeServices.find#RateAmount, as a time entry finds its rates), and why: what the rate found is scoped to. For one who manages money; the worker rate of a person who is an employee is the employee's pay, only with PAYROLL_VIEW (mantle.humanres.EmploymentServices.get#PayRateAccess).

BillingSettings (design-projects.md §12): the organization's billing defaults for its projects (PartySetting ProjBillingDefaults, a JSON object; mantle.work.ProjectServices.get#ProjectSettings reads the keys of the project settings WstBillingBasis billingBasis, WstInvoiceGrouping invoiceGrouping, WstTimeDetail timeDetail and WstShareHours shareHours): billingBasis (TimeAndMaterials, FixedPrice, Milestones, NotBilled), invoiceGrouping (PerEntry, PerWorker, OneLine), timeDetail (time detail on invoices), shareHours (hours shared with clients), settlementTermId (the payment terms of a new invoice) and workerInvoicing (Monthly or ByProject: how contractors bill their time). The organization is the settings one (ironstone.projects.ProjectServices.get#SettingsOrganization) unless organizationPartyId is given.

BillingSettings' form, for the Projects managers who manage money: the organization's ProjBillingDefaults (a JSON object under the 255 characters of a PartySetting, impl-projects.md F9). Each project may set its own billing basis, grouping, time detail and shared hours (its Settings, WorkEffortSetting rows), which win over these.

ProjectDetail's Money tab (design-projects.md §4 ProjectMoney): for one who manages money and sees the project (mantle.work.ProjectServices.get#ProjectMoneySummary), else money is null. The texts of Budget and actuals (the caps, the hours and their cost and value, profit, budget used), Unbilled (the time ready and waiting, expenses, the milestone shares due; Create invoice when it may be invoiced), Milestone billing (each share: milestone, order line, percent, amount, status: billed with its invoice, due, waiting for approval, not reached), Invoices (client invoices) and Expenses (expense invoices), Commercial (the order lines it fulfils, linked to OrderDetail); the billing basis; whether the user manages the project (canManage: the edits, Send estimate, link a line); and the maintenance work charged to the project with its cost by currency (maintenanceRows, maintenanceTotalText; impl-maintenance P11, an owner contract: the repair is a project cost).

service.description: The order lines a project may fulfil (design-projects.md §4 ProjectMoneyStep's order line, Commercial): the lines of sales orders to the project's client not cancelled, rejected or completed, not yet the project's, by the order id or the line's or order's words, as drop-down options [{value: 'orderId:orderItemSeqId', label}], up to 20. For one who manages money and manages the project; else none.

Links (or with remove unlinks) an order line to a project (mantle.work.ProjectServices.link#ProjectOrderItem): orderLine is 'orderId:orderItemSeqId' (the search's value), or orderId and orderItemSeqId. For one who manages money and manages the project.
A milestone's billing share of an order line (mantle.work.ProjectServices.store#MilestoneShare): kind percent or amount with value, or remove. For one who manages money and manages the project.

Invoice milestone (design-projects.md §4 MilestoneDetail, §10 MilestonesDue): the milestone's shares due on a client invoice (mantle.account.InvoiceServices.create#MilestoneInvoiceItems), added to an open draft of the project to its client (invoiceId) or a new one with the payment terms. For one who manages money and manages the project; in one transaction.

Unbilled's Milestones due (design-projects.md §10 MilestonesDue): the milestone billing shares due (reached, approved when gated, not billed; mantle.work.ProjectServices.get#MilestoneBilling with dueOnly) of the projects the user sees, by project or client: milestone, project, client, order line, share, amount, reached; with Invoice for those who manage the project. For one who manages money; else an error.

Whether the user may see an order in Projects: one who manages money and sees one of the projects it is linked to (OrderItemWorkEffort to a project or one of its work efforts); else "not available" as an error, or with need none only the answer. projectIds: those projects; canManage: the user manages one of them.

OrderDetail in the Projects context (design-projects.md §10 OrderDetail): for one who may see the order (get#OrderAccess), else detail is null. The header (customer, vendor, status, dates, total, the order's name), the lines (each with its total, the projects and milestones it is linked to and their shares, billed), the milestone shares (get#MilestoneBilling), the invoices that bill it (OrderItemBilling), the projects; the actions: Send estimate for approval (one project, the user manages it, the order open or proposed), Print (the estimate of its project), link a line to the project.

Send estimate for approval (design-projects.md §4 ProjectMoney): mantle.work.ProjectServices.send#EstimateForApproval for a project the user manages, by one who manages money: the estimate kept as a file of the Estimate milestone and its gate's approval requested from the client.
Home's Unbilled counter text (design-projects.md §3): get#ProjectHomeCounts unbilledAmount formatted in its currency; empty when it is null (not one who manages money).
